paragraphs.text: The Five Trees are located in the Jukai forest in Kamigawa .

The Five Trees are located in their respective cardinal relations: the Winter Tree in the north, the Summer Tree in the south, the Autumn Tree in the West, the Summer Tree in the East, and the Tree of All Seasons in the center. The Five Trees have spiritual significance, and each has its own kodama.
The Autumn Tree, protected by the Kodama of the West Tree
The Spring Tree, protected by the Kodama of the East Tree
The Summer Tree, protected by the Kodama of the South Tree
The Winter Tree, protected by the Kodama of the North Tree
The Tree of All Seasons - the tallest of the Five Trees, protected by the Kodama of the Center Tree

Little is known of events regarding the Five Trees during the Kami War , although their kodamas all joined the side of the kami against the mortal world. The trees and their kodamas are still around 1200 years later, during the Neon Dynasty ."
